mechanism: Piperacillin-tazobactam may increase infection risk in patients on TNF-alpha inhibitors like adalimumab, which are already immunosuppressive; additionally, beta-lactams can rarely cause hypersensitivity reactions that may be masked or complicated by immunosuppression.
action: Monitor closely for signs of infection or delayed hypersensitivity reactions; ensure appropriate infection control measures and consider infection risk-benefit analysis when prescribing antibiotics to patients on adalimumab.
